# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/mech_sun.mjs, spec docs/specs/04_mechanics/lands_of_the_sun.md). Do not edit by hand.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_sun_started } }
				set_global_flag = zin_sun_started
				zin_sun_startup = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { zin_sun_is_runner = yes }
				zin_sun_monthly = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_declare_war = {
		effect = {
			zin_sun_on_declare_war = yes
		}
	}
	on_capitulation_immediate = {
		effect = {
			zin_sun_on_capitulation = yes
		}
	}
	on_state_control_changed = {
		effect = {
			zin_sun_on_state_control = yes
		}
	}
}
